programs.title_tr: Pratt & Whitney GTF (PW1100G) Toz Metal Kusuru & Yere İndirmeler
programs.title_en: Pratt & Whitney GTF (PW1100G) Powder Metal Defect & Groundings
programs.current_status_tr: Yüksek basınçlı türbin disklerindeki mikroskobik toz metal kirliliği nedeniyle küresel çapta yüzlerce A320neo/A321neo uçağı planlanmamış motor bakımına alındı. Ortalama motor revizyon süresi (TAT) 250-300 günü buluyor.
programs.current_status_en: Contaminated powder metal in high-pressure turbine disks required accelerated inspections; hundreds of A320neo family jets grounded globally with MRO shop turnaround times reaching 250-300 days.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: THY filosundaki yaklaşık 30-40 adet A320/A321neo uçağı yerde bekliyor; kapasite açığını kapatmak için ıslak kiralama (wet lease) ve mevcut A320ceo uçaklarının hizmet ömrünü uzatma yoluna gidildi. Pegasus filosu ağırlıklı CFM LEAP motorlu olduğu için doğrudan etkilenmedi.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Turkish Airlines has 30-40 A321neo aircraft parked; capacity shortfall managed via wet leases and extending older A320ceo service lives. Pegasus remains largely unaffected due to CFM LEAP engine selection.
programs.timeline_horizon: 2026 yılı boyunca ve 2027 ilk yarısına kadar sürmesi bekleniyor.
programs.source_reference: RTX Corporation / FAA Airworthiness Directives (AD 2024-0044) / THY KAP Açıklamaları

programs.title_tr: Boeing 737 MAX Üretim Kısıtı (FAA Aylık 38 Tavanı) & Tedarik Zinciri
programs.title_en: Boeing 737 MAX FAA Monthly 38 Cap & Supply Chain Bottlecks
programs.current_status_tr: FAA'in kalite ve montaj denetimleri kapsamında Boeing 737 üretimini aylık 38 uçak tavanında tutması ve Spirit AeroSystems gövde teslimat gecikmeleri nedeniyle 2026 teslimat takvimleri 3-6 ay geriye ötelendi. MAX 7 ve MAX 10 sertifikasyonu gecikmeye devam ediyor.
programs.current_status_en: FAA capped 737 production at 38/month pending quality audit milestones; Spirit AeroSystems fuselage supply constraints pushed airline delivery slots back by 3 to 6 months. MAX 7 and MAX 10 certification remains pending.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: SunExpress ve THY teslimatları planlanan takvimin gerisinde seyrediyor; havayolları yoğun yaz ve sonbahar kapasite planlamalarını mevcut gövdelerle optimize ediyor.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: SunExpress and Turkish Airlines delivery streams experiencing slot postponements; carriers optimizing utilization on existing fleet assets.
programs.timeline_horizon: Aylık 38 üretim tavanının 2026 sonuna kadar aşamalı olarak artırılması hedefleniyor.
programs.source_reference: FAA Oversight Directives / Boeing Quarterly Deliveries / Airline Fleet Filings

programs.title_tr: Airbus A321XLR Ticari Teslimatları & Dar Gövde Uzun Menzil Devrimi
programs.title_en: Airbus A321XLR Entry into Service & Long-Range Narrowbody Wave
programs.current_status_tr: EASA tip sertifikasyonunu tamamlayan A321XLR, Iberia tarafından Madrid-Boston hattında ilk ticari uçuşlarına başladı. 4.700 deniz mili (8.700 km) menziliyle dar gövdede transatlantik ve kıtalararası uçuş maliyetlerini %30 düşürüyor.
programs.current_status_en: Having achieved EASA certification, the A321XLR commenced transatlantic operations with launch customer Iberia. Its 4,700 nm range unlocks thin long-haul routes at 30% lower trip cost.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: Orta Doğu, Afrika ve ikincil Avrupa şehirlerine doğrudan bağlantı potansiyeli nedeniyle bölge taşıyıcıları tarafından yakından izleniyor. THY ve Pegasus filo stratejilerinde uzun vadeli alternatif.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Closely monitored by regional carriers for secondary point-to-point routes into Africa, Central Asia and Europe; potential long-term fit for Istanbul network.
programs.source_reference: EASA Type Certificate Data Sheet (TCDS) / Airbus Commercial Aircraft Updates

programs.title_tr: Boeing 777-9 (777X) Test Uçuşları & Hizmete Giriş Tarihi
programs.current_status_tr: İtiş kolu bağlantı elemanındaki (thrust link) teknik arıza sonrası test uçuşları geçici olarak durdurulmuştu; Boeing ilk teslimat takvimini 2026 yılına (ve potansiyel olarak 2027'ye) revize etti. Başta Emirates ve Lufthansa olmak üzere amiral gemisi filoları A380 ve 777-300ER ömür uzatmak zorunda kaldı.
programs.current_status_en: Structural component inspection on engine thrust links required test fleet pause; initial deliveries rescheduled to 2026/2027. Major customers Emirates and Lufthansa forced to extend legacy 777-300ER and A380 service lives.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: THY'nin geniş gövde siparişlerinde Airbus A350-1000'e ağırlık vermesinde 777X gecikmeleri belirleyici stratejik etken oldu.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Delays were a primary catalyst for Turkish Airlines' decision to anchor its high-capacity widebody order book on the Airbus A350-1000.
programs.timeline_horizon: FAA tip sertifikasyonu ve ilk ticari teslimat 2026 sonu / 2027 hedefleniyor.
programs.source_reference: Boeing Defense, Space & Security / Airline IR Filings / Emirates President Statements

programs.title_tr: CFM LEAP-1A / 1B Yüksek Basınç Türbini Dayanıklılığı & MRO Bekleme Süreleri
programs.title_en: CFM LEAP-1A / 1B Hot-Section Durability & Shop Visit Backlogs
programs.current_status_tr: Sıcak iklim, tozlu hava sahası ve yüksek iniş-kalkış döngüsü altında çalışan LEAP motorlarında türbin kanatçığı erozyonu nedeniyle planlanandan erken motor indirme yaşanıyor. Küresel MRO atölyelerinde yedek parça ve motor kıtlığı devam ediyor.
programs.current_status_en: Harsh environment operations (heat, sand, high cycle utilization) causing premature hot-section turbine blade wear; global MRO shops experiencing parts constraints and extended turn-around times.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: Pegasus'un filosunun belkemiğini oluşturan A321neo uçaklarında CFM LEAP-1A motorları kullanılıyor. Pegasus, proaktif motor rotasyonu ve yedek motor rezervasyonu ile uçak yerde kalma süresini (AOG) asgaride tutuyor.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Pegasus relies heavily on CFM LEAP-1A on its A321neo fleet; carrier leverages proactive engine rotation and buffer lease pools to keep AOG rates minimal.
programs.timeline_horizon: CFM'in güncellenmiş dayanıklı parça (durability kit) teslimatları 2026 boyunca yaygınlaşıyor.
programs.source_reference: Safran / GE Aerospace Engine Technical Briefings / Aviation Week MRO Watch

stories.lead: An 18-page report by IdeaWorksCompany highlights United Airlines' strategy centered on premium customer proposition, loyalty programs, co-branded credit cards, and ancillary revenue. Authored by Jay Sorensen, the report examines initiatives introduced throughout 2025 and 2026.
stories.source_description: United Airlines is rapidly reshaping its customer proposition around premium experiences, loyalty, co-branded cards and ancillary revenue, according to a new 18-page IdeaWorksCompany report, “United is Winning the Race for Brand-Loyal Consumers.” Written by airline revenue and loyalty expert Jay Sorensen, the report examines United’s expanding portfolio of products and strategies introduced during 2025 and 2026. That’s more than 25 million guests per year, which is equal to the annual passenger traffic of JetBlue. The report also examines United’s “Base” fares for the Premium Plus and Polaris cabins, which removes certain benefits, such as Polaris lounge access and advance seat assignments, for a lower fare.

stories.headline: Boeing Commercial Market Outlook Projects Global Fleet Growth to 2045
stories.lead: Boeing forecasts that the global commercial aircraft fleet will grow nearly 80% to over 50,000 airplanes by 2045. Airlines and cargo operators will require nearly 44,000 new aircraft over the next 20 years to support air travel and cargo expansion.
stories.source_description: The global commercial airplanes fleet is expected to grow nearly 80% to more than 50,000 airplanes by 2045 as airlines and cargo operators add capacity. Globally, operators are forecasted to need nearly 44,000 new airplanes to support sustained air travel demand and air cargo expansion over the next 20 years. The global single-aisle fleet will nearly double to more than 36,000 jets, serving core short-haul networks and operating more than half of all global capacity. More than 8,000 widebody airplanes will be in service in 2045, enabling long-haul passenger routes, enhanced passenger experience and critical air cargo capacity. Air cargo traffic growth and the need for new-technology freighters to renew the fleet will drive demand for more than 2,900 production and converted freighters. Passenger traffic is expected to grow 4% annually, resulting in a doubling of global air traffic between 2026 and 2045.

stories.headline: London Heathrow Retains Top Spot in OAG Megahubs 2025 Connectivity Rankings
stories.lead: London Heathrow retained its title as the world's most connected airport for the third consecutive year in the OAG Megahubs 2025 ranking. Meanwhile, Istanbul Airport and Frankfurt registered substantial connectivity gains, while Tokyo Haneda experienced a decline.
stories.source_description: London Heathrow (LHR) retains its title as the world’s most connected airport for the third consecutive year , offering over 59,000 possible connections to 226 destinations* on the busiest day**. Istanbul Airport (IST) has seen one of the greatest increases, surging from 8 th position last year to 2 nd place in this year’s ranking, due to a 25% year-on-year increase in potential connections on the busiest day of the year. Frankfurt (FRA) has seen a significant shift in rankings, climbing from 10 th position last year to 4 th , driven by a 21% increase in potential connections year-on-year. Tokyo Haneda (HND) has dropped down in this year’s rankings from 3 rd in 2024 to 9 th in 2025, reflecting a 10% decline in connections. Atlanta Hartsfield-Jackson (ATL) – the world’s largest airport by seat capacity – re-enters the Top 10 this year rising from 11 th place last year to 8 th position in 2025. ATL has added eight (8) more destinations and seen a corresponding 14% increase in potential connections. Chicago O’Hare (ORD) also makes gains, climbing two (2) spots to 7th, due to a 17% growth in connections and an expanded network of 15 additional destinations.
detailed_analysis: London Heathrow (LHR) offers over 59,000 possible connections to 226 destinations on its busiest day to hold 1st place for the third consecutive year.
Istanbul Airport (IST) climbed from 8th position last year to 2nd place following a 25% year-on-year increase in potential connections on its busiest day.
Frankfurt (FRA) rose from 10th position last year to 4th place, supported by a 21% year-on-year increase in potential connections.
Tokyo Haneda (HND) fell from 3rd place in 2024 to 9th place in 2025, reflecting a 10% decline in connections.

stories.headline: Delta Air Lines and Fundación Patagonia Azul Launch Marine Education Initiative in Chile
stories.lead: Delta Air Lines has renewed its commitment to ocean conservation in Chile by partnering with Fundación Patagonia Azul for an educational program in the Juan Fernández Archipelago. The initiative expands on Delta's ongoing four-year joint venture partnership with LATAM in South America.
stories.source_description: Delta Air Lines renewed its commitment to Chile’s ocean and once again joined forces with Fundación Patagonia Azul, this time to support a new Marine Conservation Education Program for the Juan Fernández Archipelago. The initiative brought the island’s marine heritage into the classroom on an ongoing basis for the first time, as a complement to the formal school curriculum, and accompanied students from early childhood education through the end of high school. “Chile is home to LATAM, our partner airline in South America, and over these four years of joint venture we have built a commitment here that goes beyond connecting destinations," said Soledad Lago Rodriguez, Communications Manager for Latin America at Delta Air Lines. " Supporting the protection of Chile’s ocean, now from the classrooms of Juan Fernández, is part of that commitment." Delta Air Lines x Fundación Patagonia Azul Remote video URL Download Video First Patagonia, then Juan Fernández The partnership began in 2025 in Chilean Patagonia. That year, Delta and Fundación Patagonia Azul supported the communities of the Pitipalena-Añihué Multiple-Use Coastal Marine Protected Area with cutting-edge technology and training to strengthen the monitoring and protection of their ecosystem. In the second year, the focus shifted to education, reaching the students growing up to safeguard one of the most valuable territories on the planet for biodiversity and marine conservation. The timing was no coincidence. At the time, Juan Fernández was seeking to make history with the expansion of the Mar de Juan Fernández and Nazca-Desventuradas Marine Parks, aiming to protect a 337,230 km² sanctuary, similar in size to Germany. The idea for the initiative originated within the island’s own community of artisanal fishers. However, that biocultural heritage still had no place in the classroom. The enormous challenges of this island territory, including high teacher turnover, a lack of materials adapted to island life, and the absence of an educational repository on the island, had prevented environmental education initiatives from being sustained over time. Learning from the ocean at every stage of school To help close that gap, the program was designed together with the community, with scientific grounding and collaboration, and offered learning experiences tailored to each educational level and deeply connected to the island. The youngest children, in nursery and kindergarten, discovered their surroundings through play, sensory exploration and the observation of endemic and migratory birds, such as the Juan Fernández firecrown and the shearwater. From first grade through the final year of high school, students progressed through hands-on units that turned the island into a living laboratory. They explored the rocky intertidal zone, the water cycle in the Biosphere Reserve, seabirds, food webs, currents, algae and endemism. They also studied the archipelago’s marine culture, ocean acidification caused by climate change and the role of Multiple-Use Conservation Areas. To ensure this learning would endure, Delta’s contribution equipped the schools with durable materials adapted to the island’s conditions: magnetic intertidal profiles, interactive maps of the archipelago and Cumberland Bay, and laboratory equipment. These were complemented by a Teacher’s Handbook created to serve as a local orientation guide for teachers arriving on the island. The program also put people at its center. For one week, a team of three specialists, the same experts who co-designed the program, traveled to Robinson Crusoe Island. There, they trained teachers and supported them in the classroom and in the field to implement the project’s first pilot units with students. An entire island learning The program’s reach was complete: it was offered free of charge to 100% of the municipality’s school enrollment. It directly benefited 256 people: 22 children from the Sandalito Kindergarten and Nursery, 169 students from Colegio Insular Robinson Crusoe and 65 teachers, education professionals, technicians and assistants, a significant contribution to public education on the island. Its impact also extended beyond the school. Around 1,000 people in San Juan Bautista benefited indirectly, including families, artisanal fishers and tourism and diving operators. They took part through science fairs, exhibitions and citizen science projects that brought what was learned in the classroom to the rest of the community. A collective effort The program was the result of a broad collaboration among local, academic and civil society organizations. Participants included the Mar de Juan Fernández Functional Community Organization; the Coastal Marine Research Station (ECIM) of the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, through its Chile es Mar project; Colegio Insular Robinson Crusoe; Sandalito Kindergarten; and Fondo Naturaleza Chile. Fundación Patagonia Azul channeled Delta’s funding to address the operational and logistical challenges of working on an oceanic island in one of the most remote areas of Chilean territory. A legacy that stays on the island “Juan Fernández is close to having its entire exclusive economic zone protected, which will make it one of the largest marine protected areas on the planet, with nearly one million square kilometers under protection," said Cristian Laborda, Executive Director of Fundación Patagonia Azul. "For this level of protection to endure and be sustainable, we need to teach children from an early age. With this program, the ocean surrounding the island enters the classroom and becomes learning that stays in the territory, even when teachers change." With the project concluded, everything that was built remained in the hands of the community. The materials, the Teacher’s Handbook and the skills developed among teachers now form a repository that the island itself manages independently. As a result, every new teacher who arrives on Robinson Crusoe has the tools to teach about the ocean that surrounds their students, and every child in the archipelago can grow up knowing the ocean their community chose to protect. With this second phase, Delta and Fundación Patagonia Azul reinforced a shared conviction: ocean conservation is sustained over time when it is rooted in local communities and passed down from generation to generation. From Patagonia to Juan Fernández, the partnership added a new chapter to the same story: that of a Chile that sees the ocean as part of its identity and that, from the classrooms of Robinson Crusoe, has been shaping its next “Guardians of the Sea.”

stories.headline: Delta Promotes Digital Self-Service Features to Handle Holiday Passenger Traffic

Save time before and after arriving at the airport Scan and save your documents. Saving your passport in the Fly Delta app can speed up document verification and make future international trips easier. It does not replace your physical passport, which you must still carry when traveling internationally. You can also scan other travel documents, like U.S. and Canada resident cards, and review country-specific travel requirements. Add your Known Traveler Number (KTN). Add or edit it directly in the app for expedited security screening with TSA PreCheck. Don’t see TSA Pre-Check on your boarding pass? Ask Delta Concierge to check and add your KTN for you. Use App Bag Drop. Once you have checked in and added your bags in the app, use the dedicated App Bag Drop kiosk to print your bag tag and skip the main queue at Delta hubs. Try TSA Precheck’s Touchless ID. Eligible customers can use dedicated bag drop and security lines without presenting a traditional photo ID. Save your passport to your SkyMiles profile and opt into Touchless ID to enroll. Redeem miles toward checked bags: Use miles to cover fees for standard checked bags on flights originating from select U.S. airports. Select “Pay with Miles” during check-in on delta.com and the Fly Delta app or at an airport kiosk. Find your way. Use interactive airport maps from your app boarding pass to locate gates, lounges and amenities. Update the Delta app before you leave for the airport. Delta's newest features and updates appear only on the latest app version. Pro-Tip: To ensure you have the latest version, tap the Delta app from the app store to check. 2. Enable Live Activities (iPhone) or Live Updates (Android) for real-time alerts On iPhone, Live Activities puts a timeline of your trip on your lock screen so there’s no hunting for your flight details. Dynamic Island provides real-time updates for your flight including boarding start time and zones, beginning three hours before departure. On select Android devices, Live Updates delivers real-time alerts on your lock and home screens. Make sure this feature is activated to see gate assignments and boarding time changes, plus your boarding zone, seat number, and after landing, your bag carousel. 3. Track your bags real-time Whether in the app or asking Delta Concierge, your checked bags are never far. The app gives you a bag tracking map and real-time notifications while Delta Concierge will pull and summarize bag status across your trip. Delta carries more than 400,000 bags a day during the Thanksgiving peak, and more than 99% arrive on time. 4. See your SkyMiles account details in seconds In the app, SkyMiles Members can go to Profile andcheck your mileage balance, the Medallion Qualification Dollars (MQDs) you have earned toward Medallion Status, and your eCredits. Try this Concierge prompt: “What's my medallion status? Can I get to the next level by Dec. 31?" 5. List yourself for standby if you are delayed or your flight is cancelled If a delay or cancellation affects you, Delta will rebook you whenever possible while also providing you with other options, including listing yourself standby on an earlier flight in the app, even if Delta has already rebooked you. View available flights, join the list and track your status in real time. Standby listing is available for nonstop, domestic flights only. 6. Plan your Delta Sky Club® visit A visit to one of Delta’s award-winning lounges is a part of a smoother, more seamless travel day. Use the app to check eligibility requirements and strategically plan your visit with the app’s occupancy tracker. With a quick glance, you can see how busy each lounge is — helping you plan your visit and choose the best location for a relaxing break. Tap “Delta Sky Club” section in the app to see real-time occupancy levels for your Club of choice. 7. Stay connected in the air Free for SkyMiles Members. Free global Wi-Fi presented by T-Mobile is on more than 1,300 aircraft, over 95% of the fleet, across domestic and international routes. It's easy to connect . Once the boarding doors close, turn on Airplane Mode and select "DeltaWiFi.com" from the Wi-Fi networks. Then, log in with your SkyMiles credentials. If the login page doesn't open, type "DeltaWiFi.com" into your browser. Plus, you can connect on multiple devices to stay logged in across your phone, laptop or tablet. 8. Plan your in-flight watch party before you board Once you're buckled in, the holiday rush is behind you, your trip can finally start to feel like a getaway. Make the most of that time in the air with Delta Sync . SkyMiles Members can log in to free global Wi-Fi presented by T-Mobile to find entertainment, news and live sports from partners including YouTube, Paramount+, Crunchyroll, The New York Times and The Wall Street Journal. On aircraft with Delta Sync seatback screens, connect your SkyMiles account using the Delta app and the screen can offer personalized recommendations, resume select shows and save your favorites. Offers and content vary by flight and market. Explore the latest offerings before your trip here . 9. Start dreaming about your next getaway Who says you need to finish your current vacation before you can book the next one? Use the Delta app to explore your options, compare fares across dates and find the trip that works for you, then book it right in the app. 10. Ask Delta Concierge Delta Concierge is your digital assistant in the Delta app, helping you navigate your journey and quickly get the support you need. Ask Concierge to check your flight status, support when travel is disrupted, track your bags, add your Known Traveler Number to your reservation, or look up your SkyMiles details. If you are logged in, it recognizes your upcoming trip and account information, so you can get answers without searching through your reservations. Just tap the Concierge icon in the upper right of the app home screen. Delta people are ready to get you where you’re going. The app helps you take it from there.

stories.headline: Eurowings to Launch Damascus Services from Four German Cities in January 2027
stories.lead: Eurowings will introduce direct flights to Damascus from Berlin, Dusseldorf, Hamburg, and Stuttgart starting in January 2027. The expansion strengthens the airline's leadership in the visiting friends and relatives segment.
stories.source_description: From January 2027, Eurowings will connect Berlin, Dusseldorf, Hamburg and Stuttgart with the Syrian capital. New routes expand the offering for family and home visits Eurowings is a leader in this segment, with 60 routes to more than 20 destinations Flights to Damascus are now available to book Eurowings is adding Damascus to its route network for the first time. From January 2027, the airline will offer direct flights from Berlin, Dusseldorf, Hamburg and Stuttgart to the Syrian capital. Travellers from the catchment areas of these four German metropolitan regions will be able to fly to Damascus without a stopover. The new ser vices are aimed in particular at travellers with personal ties to the region who wish to visit family and friends or travel to their home country. All flights are available to book now. The average flight time is around 4.5 hours. A growing offering for visiting friends and relatives With its new routes to Damascus, Eurowings is expanding its offering for travellers visiting family and friends or returning to their home country. The Lufthansa Group airline already operates numerous flights in this segment, including services to Armenia, Georgia, Greece, Croatia, Morocco, Tunisia, Lebanon and Iraq. Eurowings recently announced that it would launch a route to the Iraqi capital, Baghdad, in December, with two flights a week from each of Berlin and Dusseldorf. Eurowings is a market leader in the visiting friends and relatives’ segment and is further strengthening its position as demand continues to grow. This means more travellers can benefit from direct connections to their home countries. Eurowings’ offering in this segment currently includes more than 60 routes to over 20 destinations in Europe and beyond. The new Damascus routes at a glance: Berlin - Damascus: Wednesdays, starting 13 January 2027 Dusseldorf - Damascus: Tuesdays and Thursdays, starting 12 January 2027 Hamburg - Damascus: Mondays, starting 11 January 2027 Stuttgart - Damascus: Wednesdays, starting 13 January 2027 Eurowings’ offering for visiting family and friends and travelling home: Albania: Tirana (TIA) Armenia: Yerevan (EVN) Bosnia and Herzegovina: Sarajevo (SJJ), Mostar (OMO) Croatia: Zagreb (ZAG) Egypt: Cairo (CAI) Georgia: Tbilisi (TBS) Greece: Kavala (KVA), Preveza (PVK), Thessaloniki (SKG) Iraq: Baghdad (BGW), Erbil (EBL) Jordan: Amman (AMM) Kosovo: Pristina (PRN) Lebanon: Beirut (BEY) Morocco: Casablanca (CMN), Nador (NDR) Montenegro: Tivat (TIV) Romania: Bucharest (OTP) Serbia: Belgrade (BEG) Syria: Damascus (DAM) Tunisia: Tunis (TUN) Turkey: Antalya (AYT) About Eurowings Eurowings is the value airline of the Lufthansa Group and thus part of Europe's largest airline group. With its clear positioning as Europe's value carrier for leisure and business travellers, Eurowings clearly distinguishes itself from the ultra-low-cost carrier segment, allowing its customers to fly affordably and flexibly with numerous booking options and extras as well as customer-friendly services. With its value concept, the German airline is responding to the core needs of today's air travellers: even greater flexibility, comfort and ease. Eurowings offers direct flights to around 150 destinations within Europe. With 10 international bases – including Mallorca as Europe's number one vacation island – the Lufthansa subsidiary is one of the largest leisure airlines in Europe. It currently has a fleet of around 100 aircraft and employs 5,500 people. About Lufthansa Group The Lufthansa Group is an aviation group with operations worldwide. With 100,000+ employees from 164 nations worldwide, Lufthansa Group generated revenue of €37.6bn in the financial year 2024. Our largest business segment is Passenger Airlines while other key business segments include Logistics and Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO). Other companies and Group functions such as IT companies and Lufthansa Aviation Training form complementary components of the Group. All airlines and business segments play leading roles in their respective markets.
